kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Greetings from Syria, where time seems to melt as a glassmaker braves scorching temps
wire.summary: As a Syrian glassmaker created his wares in Damascus, watching his craft reminded this reporter to slow down and enjoy the moment.

wire.title: Police questioning can shape a sexual assault case. Their approach is often wrong
wire.summary: The Cornell lawsuit filed by a woman alleging a brutal rape raises questions on how police handle such cases. The majority of police lack adequate training on trauma-informed approaches, experts say.

wire.title: Trump officials changed forms for overseas voters amid a GOP push to restrict voting
wire.summary: The Pentagon made last-minute changes to forms that many overseas U.S. citizens use for absentee voting, removing a category of citizens that Republicans have been pushing to block from voting.

wire.title: How Ukrainians are coping with new, more deadly Russian attacks
wire.summary: Zanny Minton Beddoes, The Economist's editor in chief , just visited Ukraine. She says, despite all its drone weaponry, Kyiv is under extraordinary bombardment, as Russia tries to make it unlivable.

wire.title: How Trump keeps undercutting his anti-communist message
wire.summary: The Trump administration has taken government equity stakes in more than three dozen private companies.

wire.title: After failed execution, health workers say Tennessee's method flouts medical ethics
wire.summary: After a botched lethal injection in May, dozens of Tennessee medical professionals told the governor that healthcare professionals shouldn't help with executions, no matter the method.

wire.title: A pilot stabs the other pilot and tries to crash their flight to Tel Aviv, Israel says
wire.summary: As the plane went into a spin and began to plunge, a passenger and crew members got into the cockpit, subdued the pilot and diverted the flight to land in Saudi Arabia, Israel's leader says.

wire.title: FBI hunting the hackers who stole its employees' sensitive data
wire.summary: The FBI says it's addressing a massive data breach, vowing to go after the hackers it believes are responsible.

wire.title: U.S. forces exit Iraq amid Iran war. And, SCOTUS revives Trump deportation policy
wire.summary: The U.S. has withdrawn its final troops from Iraq, leaving its defense future uncertain. And, the Supreme Court has sided for now with the Trump administration on third-country deportations.

wire.title: Travel plans? Here's what to know as measles exposures reach trains and games
wire.summary: Measles is traveling, with outbreaks in Pennsylvania, Ohio and New York, and exposures on transportation and in sports. What should you know before getting on a plane or train?

wire.title: What we know about stabbing on Flydubai flight to Israel
wire.summary: The captain and first officer were injured, and one pilot has been arrested, officials say.

wire.title: Six smugglers jailed for manslaughter over worst Channel small boats disaster
wire.summary: Thirty-one migrants died when their boat went down in November 2021. The trial found that the guilty men were part of two smuggling networks.

wire.title: UK-France 'one in, one out' migrant scheme scrapped
wire.summary: Some 1,500 people have been removed to France since the scheme began just over a year ago.

wire.title: Execution of US murderer Christa Pike halted shortly before it was due to happen
wire.summary: Pike was convicted and sentenced to death in 1996 for the murder of Colleen Slemmer.

wire.title: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring
wire.summary: In total 11 regions of the country were attacked overnight, with residential buildings and railways also targeted, the Ukrainian PM says.

wire.title: Last UK and US troops leave Iraq as anti-Islamic State mission ends
wire.summary: The withdrawal of coalition forces, under a deal agreed two years ago, was a key demand of the Iraqi government.
